content: Admission Form (Lateral) - this is for students applying for lateral entry admission (mid-program transfer/entry).
Revision Tenure Track System Annual Assessment Proforma - this is for faculty on the Tenure Track System to submit their annual performance assessment.
Hostel Admission Form (2023) - this is for students applying for hostel/dormitory admission (2023 version).
Degree Form - this is for applying to receive/collect an official degree certificate.
Student ID Card Form 2023 - this is for students to apply for/renew their official student ID card.
Employee ID Card Form 2023 - this is for university employees to apply for/renew their official ID card.
Transport Requisition Form (Local) - this is for requesting university transport for local trips.
Transport Requisition Form (Outstation) - this is for requesting university transport for outstation/out-of-city trips.
7th Convocation Registration Form - this is for graduating students to register for the 7th convocation ceremony.
Password Reset Performa - this is for requesting a reset of a university system/email password.
Hostel Admission Form (combo) - this is for students applying for hostel admission (combined/current version).
Hostel Visitor Form - this is for registering visitors who come to meet students at the hostel.
Budget Details for Financial Year 2021-2022 - this is for viewing the university's approved budget for FY 2021-2022.
Convocation Form 2022 - this is for students registering for the 2022 convocation ceremony.
SBBWU Best University Teacher Award 2020 Proforma - this is for nominating/evaluating faculty for the Best University Teacher Award 2020.
MS/M.Phil & Ph.D Admission Form - this is for applicants applying to MS/M.Phil or PhD programs.
PhD Country Directory Proforma - this is for PhD scholars/students to submit their country/location directory information.
Leave Performas - this is a collection (zip) of leave application proformas for university staff.
Maternity Leave Form - this is for female employees to apply for maternity leave.
Best University Researcher (Evaluation/Nomination Proforma) - this is for nominating/evaluating faculty for the Best University Researcher Award.
Best University Teacher (Evaluation/Nomination Proforma) 2018 - this is for nominating/evaluating faculty for the Best University Teacher Award (2018 version).
Faculty Resume/CV (Template) - this is for faculty members to use the university's standard CV/resume format.
Rechecking Form - this is for students requesting rechecking of their exam paper/marks.
Recounting Form - this is for students requesting recounting of their exam marks/results.
Clearance Form - this is a general clearance slip for students/staff before leaving/completing their program or role.
Name Correction Form - this is for students requesting a correction to their name in university records/documents.
College to College Migration Form - this is for students of affiliated colleges migrating from one college to another under SBBWU.
Verification Form - this is for requesting verification of a degree/certificate/transcript issued by SBBWU.
Refund Form - this is for requesting a refund of fees paid to the university.
IT Complaint Performa - this is for reporting IT-related issues/complaints to the IT Centre.
House Undertaking Form - this is for employees taking an official undertaking related to allotted university housing.
House Lease Agreement - this is for the official lease agreement document related to university housing.
House Certificate - this is a certificate document related to university housing allotment.
Application for House Subsidy - this is for employees applying for a housing subsidy.
Clearance Form (NOC) - this is for obtaining a No Objection Certificate (NOC) related clearance.
Circular - Microsoft IT Academy - this is a circular/notice about the Microsoft IT Academy program.

Best University Teacher (Evaluation/Nomination Proforma) - this is another/updated version of the proforma for nominating faculty for the Best University Teacher Award.
DVC Hall Circular - this is a circular/notice related to the DVC Hall (a university venue/hostel hall).
Internet Policy 2016 - this is the university's official internet usage policy document (2016).
University Ranking Proforma 2014 - this is a proforma related to national/international university ranking submissions (2014).

Performa For Attendance - this is for recording/reporting student or staff attendance.
USAID MNBS Application Form - this is for applying to the USAID Merit and Needs Based Scholarship (MNBS) program.
